items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Gene Goldkette also got them a contract to record for Victor.

ctx.x: So going back to McKinney Cottonpickers, that turned out to be one of the greatest dance bands in the country at that time. It had the reputation. And Gene Goldkette also got them a contract to record for Victor. I think it was one of the first colored bands to record for Victor, you know.
